name: BeraLab GEO Engine – Generative Engine Optimization & Structured Data
author: beralabs

sections.description:
BeraLab GEO Engine is a WordPress plugin specifically engineered for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search Engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Google Gemini, Claude, and Copilot).

While standard SEO focuses strictly on keywords and page rankings for traditional search crawlers, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) ensures your technical metadata and content structure are recognized, parsed, and cited accurately by Large Language Models (LLMs).

Unlike basic text-file generators, BeraLab GEO Engine bridges structured semantic data and crawler-accessible text indexes into a cohesive system:

1. Semantic JSON-LD Knowledge Graph

  • Generates interconnected @graph schema entities for Organization/Person, WebSite, Article, and BreadcrumbList.
  • Injects enriched knowsAbout, sameAs authoritative profiles, about, and mentions nodes derived from taxonomy relationships to establish topical authority.
  • Fully compatible with standard Schema.org specifications and Google Rich Results guidelines.

2. Dynamic llms.txt & llms-full.txt Generator

  • Exposes standard /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoints via the WordPress Rewrite API without writing static files to disk.
  • Formats clean, structured Markdown summaries optimized for AI context windows and web crawlers.
  • Built-in transient caching optimizes performance by storing structured responses in memory.

Features

  • Lightweight Architecture: Uses native WordPress Settings API without external option frameworks or heavy dependencies.
  • WordPress.org Compliant: Adheres to WordPress Coding Standards, strict input sanitization, and late output escaping.
  • Developer Friendly: Provides filters (beralab_geo_engine_schema_graph, beralab_geo_engine_llms_txt_content) for full customization.
  • Privacy Focused: Operates locally with no third-party tracking, external telemetry, or remote calls.
  • Cross-Platform Pedigree: Part of the BeraLab open source suite, also available for Joomla! as BeraLab GEO Engine for Joomla on the official Joomla! Extensions Directory (JED ID: 17790).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the beralab-geo-engine folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the .zip directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > BeraLab GEO Engine to configure your Entity profile, social links, and AI index settings.
  4. Visit yoursite.com/llms.txt in your browser to verify your dynamic AI index.
sections.faq:
What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?

GEO is the process of optimizing content and technical metadata so it can be accurately identified, parsed, and cited as an authoritative source by Generative AI engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

How does this differ from simple llms.txt plugins?

Most plugins only output a static list of URLs. BeraLab GEO Engine creates a dual-layer optimization system: it outputs deep JSON-LD Knowledge Graphs (linking entities, authors, knowsAbout topics, and semantic taxonomies) and simultaneously exposes dynamically rendered /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoints matching the entity definitions.

Does this plugin create physical files on my server?

No. Both /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt are rendered dynamically on request using WordPress rewrite rules and cached via WordPress Transients.

Can I use this alongside other SEO plugins?

Yes. BeraLab GEO Engine outputs modular JSON-LD schemas and dedicated /llms.txt endpoints that complement standard XML sitemaps and on-page SEO meta tags.

Is there an edition available for Joomla or other CMS platforms?

Yes. BeraLab provides cross-platform Generative Engine Optimization solutions. For Joomla! websites, our sister extension “BeraLab GEO Engine for Joomla” is officially verified and listed on the Joomla! Extensions Directory (JED ID: 17790, https://extensions.joomla.org/extension/geo-schema-forge-for-joomla/).

Where can I get support or get in touch?

For technical assistance, feature requests, or enterprise support, please reach out directly to the BeraLab engineering team at info@beralabs.it or visit https://beralabs.it.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Compatibility: Tested and verified up to WordPress 7.2 and PHP 8.5.
  • Fix: Suppressed duplicate BreadcrumbList JSON-LD node on WooCommerce single product pages (filterable via beralab_geo_suppress_wc_product_breadcrumbs), preserving WooCommerce’s native product_cat + Product structured data.

1.0.5

  • Security: Added JSON_HEX_TAG, JSON_HEX_AMP, JSON_HEX_APOS, and JSON_HEX_QUOT flags to wp_json_encode() for JSON-LD script-breakout protection.
  • Security: Excluded password-protected posts and pages from /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoints.
  • Fix: Corrected BreadcrumbList @id and item URLs on category, tag, and taxonomy archives using get_queried_object() and get_term_link().
  • Fix: Formatted Schema.org inLanguage property in BCP 47 format, sanitized @type with sanitize_text_field(), escaped image @id with esc_url_raw(), and implemented UTF-8 safe word counting excluding shortcodes.
  • Fix: Made /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt fallback path detection compatible with subdirectory WordPress installations and enabled invalid UTF-8 byte stripping via wp_check_invalid_utf8( $output, true ).
  • Fix: Added public post type selection and preservation for llms_post_types in admin settings sanitization.

1.0.4

  • Fix: Removed redundant ‘Tested up to’ header from main plugin PHP file docblock to ensure strict compliance with WordPress.org standard plugin header specifications.
  • Compliance: Verified and aligned plugin metadata headers and ‘beralab-geo-engine’ text domain for automated WordPress.org directory scanner validation.

1.0.3

  • Fix: Resolved WordPress.org Automated Plugin Scanning requirements.
  • Fix: Updated ‘Tested up to’ header to 7.1.
  • Fix: Standardized plugin Text Domain to ‘beralab-geo-engine’ across all files.

1.0.2

  • WordPress.org Plugin Directory compliance hardening and directory readiness bump.
  • Hardened input sanitization and late output escaping across administrative settings.
  • Validated W3C-compliant semantic JSON-LD @graph schema output structure.
  • Refined dynamic /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt virtual endpoint routing and transient caching efficiency.
  • Verified strict prefixing and PSR-4 autoloader integrity.

1.0.1

  • Compliance bump for WordPress.org Plugin Directory submission.
  • Sanitized docblocks, CSS prefixes, and asset loading.
  • Soft rewrite rules flush on activation and deactivation.
  • Enhanced markdown response headers for AI crawlers.
  • Package optimization: excluded repository banner assets and blueprints from production plugin zip.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of BeraLab GEO Engine.
  • Semantic JSON-LD Knowledge Graph generation (Organization, WebSite, Article, BreadcrumbList).
  • Dynamic /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt endpoint rendering with transient caching.
  • Native WordPress Settings API dashboard.
